XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the ML-Arena competition activity module

TABLE.NAME: mlarena
TABLE.COMMENT: Each record is one ML-Arena competition or course activity instance.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course id the activity belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name shown in the course.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field (MOODLE, HTML, PLAIN, MARKDOWN).

FIELD.NAME: reftype
FIELD.COMMENT: What is being linked: competition or course.

FIELD.NAME: joincode
FIELD.COMMENT: ML-Arena course join code or enrollment link (when reftype=course).

FIELD.NAME: display
FIELD.COMMENT: How to present the activity: 0=landing page, 1=embedded iframe.

FIELD.NAME: iframeheight
FIELD.COMMENT: Iframe height in pixels when display=embed.

FIELD.NAME: showleaderboard
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to render the competition leaderboard on the activity page.

FIELD.NAME: leaderboardcourseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional ML-Arena course id used to filter the leaderboard to that course's students.
